description: This PHP abstract class defines a base controller for the OrangeHRM system, providing common functionalities such as handling HTTP responses and redirect responses, and enforcing response type constraints.

classes.name: AbstractController
classes.description: An abstract base controller class providing methods for managing HTTP responses and redirects within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getNewResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Response object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the current response object, initializing a new one if necessary.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object, enforcing that it is either a Response, RedirectResponse, or null.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Prepares and returns a Response object with HTTP 400 Bad Request status.
